Name: The Mysterious Star Candy
Author: MarcyTheBeast
Description:
[b][size=5]The Magical Star Candy

[/size][/b][size=4]About:

[/size]This mod adds a magical fruit to the game, called the star candy. The seeds are sent to the player by the Wizard when they have maxed out their farming skill and reached an 8 heart friendship level with him. WARNING: As of now there is no other way to get the seeds, if you lose them you are not getting them back, you can however make more seeds once you have grown the candy. 

The candy sells for 590 gold each, and when eaten gives the player a bunch of health and stamina as well as quite a big amount of buffs, such as a bunch more energy and speed. There is a new cake recipe associated with it, that gives a much stronger and longer lasting buff. It's unlocked at farming level 10.

[size=4]Requirements:

[/size]This mod requires JsonAssets, as well as the Mail Framework Mod so that you can get the letter from the wizard, and their respective requirements.

[size=4]Installation:

[/size]Once you have installed the required mods, unzip the mod into your mods folder, and you're good to go.
